# @sharadox/sharadox-web-library

> Sharadox's own website library (verifiable source, not open source): content, branded components, styles and contact configuration for sharadox.com, built on the open-source @sharadox/*-web-library topic libraries.

- content/locale LOCALES (defineLocales en/pt); content/style STYLES (color group: black default, white, system; storageKey "style"); content/separator SEPARATOR "·"
- utility/separate separate(...parts) with the Sharadox separator
- action/send-contact sendContact(form, ip) — createContactAction to contact@sharadox.com, subject "Contact · Name (Company)"
- component/*: navigation, hero (+ lazy globe), service-index, statement, services (four groups of service-card, each with a service-object), touchpoint, capability, marquee, process, contact (+ form), footer, section-indicator, style-switch, structured-data, share-image (renderShareImage)
- style/token Sass helpers: tint, shade, dashed, on-scroll, below, fill-center
- License: Sharadox Verifiable Source License 0.1.0 (read and verify only)
- component/license License({ locale, markdown }) renders the license page body (marked); content/license LICENSE { path "/license", title, eyebrow, description }
- Navigation, Footer and LanguageSwitch take path? (e.g. "/license"): section links go to /<locale>#section, language links stay on the page; the footer links to the license page
- component/not-found NotFound({ locale, path }) the 404 screen (giant 404 with the live globe as the zero, failed request line, way home); content/not-found NOT_FOUND; ServiceIndex takes base? ("/<locale>" off the home page)
- content/slogan SLOGAN (with full stop) and SLOGAN_LINES; content/section SECTION { home, services, touchpoints, capabilities, process, contact } with id + names; content/action ACTION.startProject; content/language LANGUAGE { label, names }. SITE.slogan, HERO.lines, HERO.primary, NAVIGATION.<name>, FOOTER.services/language, CAPABILITY.eyebrow and CONTACT.eyebrow were removed in 0.10.0 in favor of these.
- Language switch (internationalization-web-library 0.2): entrances skip on soft navigation (hero/not-found Motion initial, Sass mixin skip-entrance($durations...) for CSS entrances); site must render <LocaleTransitionStyle /> in <head>
- Service cards: SERVICES.items (groups web-application, mobile-application, creative, marketing; anchors) each with cards [{ key, title, text, action, chip }]; a card's key is its contact choice and its 3D object; ServiceCard's button links to #contact and calls requestContactNeeds([key]) (utility/contact-need, window event CONTACT_NEED_EVENT); ContactForm ticks the chip with a glow. CONTACT.needs.groups (chips grouped like the services) + other, and options (flat). Choices: website, platform, e-commerce, android-application, ios-application, progressive-web-application, branding, rebranding, branding-design, product-launch, lead-generation, sales-generation, brand-awareness, social-media-strategy, other
- content/site FOUNDED 2026; the footer's copyright years come from CopyrightYears (@sharadox/time-web-library): "2026", then "2026–<current year>" as years pass
- utility/llms-text llmsText() → sharadox.com's llms.txt (shared shape from @sharadox/metadata-web-library). The cookie panel was removed in 0.14.0: the site stores only what it needs (language, style), which needs no consent.
- content/privacy PRIVACY (privacy-web-library options) and PRIVACY_PAGE { path "/privacy", title, eyebrow, description }; component/privacy-page PrivacyPage({ locale }); the footer links it
- 0.16.0: chevron icons from @sharadox/icon-web-library replace every text arrow (button, footer Back to top, 404)
- 0.17.0: component/consent Consent back (consent-web-library 0.3, required only: Got It and Details); footer: Cookie Preferences, Livro de Reclamações link and the CIMAAL consumer dispute notice (legal-web-library); privacy policy mentions the consent record
- 0.18.0: navigation links include One System (touchpoints); below 1100px a menu button opens the links and Start a Project under the bar, in the bar's frosted background, scrolling when it doesn't fit (Escape, a link or a wider screen closes it); footer Studio column adds One System and Start a Project
- 0.19.0: the globe floats (slow rise, fall and sway; still with reduced motion), in the hero and the 404; footer reorganized (brand, services, studio with Start a Project, language and style; wordmark; a bar with license, privacy, cookie preferences, complaints book and Back to top; copyright beside the dispute notice); the phone menu uses @sharadox/menu-web-library (any tap on a link or button in the bar or menu closes it, the logo included)
- 0.20.0: "What we do" is now Services: four groups (Web Applications: websites, platforms, e-commerce; Mobile Applications: Android, iOS, PWAs; Creative: branding, rebranding, branding design; Marketing: product launches, lead generation, sales generation, brand awareness, social media growth strategy) of cards, each with its own animated CSS 3D object (component/service-object, Cuboid primitive, style/object helpers) that turns towards the pointer (useTilt on the card), a description and a button that ticks its contact choice; contact chips grouped by service (component/contact/form/chip); service-action, services/cell and the old visuals removed; footer: no big wordmark, Start a Project is a solid button, everything legal in one section (title, copyright, links, dispute notice, Back to top); the process line fills as you scroll on phones too (--drawn); ServiceIndex has four cells and a chevron icon; structured data offers one service per card
- 0.20.1: same as 0.20.0, published again (0.20.0's npm publish failed at the provenance log)
